summary: Iteration 133 - Printer Setup Wizard Testing Complete. Backend: 15/15 tests PASSED (discovery, ad-hoc test, save, diagnostics endpoints). Frontend: All Wizard UI elements verified - 3 modes (Auto/Manual/USB), 3 steps, save gate working (disabled until test passes), testbon, discovery, diagnostics all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend PrinterTestRequest correctly accepts ad-hoc printer config (name, type, ip, port, device) for testing without saving
Backend PrinterDiscoveryRequest uses asyncio semaphore for concurrent socket probing with 0.35s timeout per host
Frontend Printer Setup Wizard has 3 modes: Auto suchen (network discovery), IP manuell (direct IP entry), USB / Pfad (USB device path)
Wizard steps dynamically update labels based on mode: 'Drucker suchen' / 'IP eingeben' / 'USB wählen'
Save Gate correctly implemented: printerVerified state controls save button disabled state, only enabled after successful testPrinter()
Discovery panel shows subnet/start/end inputs with 'Suchen' button, results list with 'Übernehmen' action
USB panel shows informational text about manual path entry and 'Native Auto-Suche folgt separat' note
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Test printer mappings created during backend testing (kitchen, service, bill roles)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 133 verified Printer Setup Wizard: (1) Backend endpoints - POST /api/table-hardware/discover returns 200 with results array, POST /api/table-hardware/printers/test accepts ad-hoc config and tests without saving, POST /api/table-hardware/printers saves mapping, POST /api/table-hardware/diagnostics runs printer check. (2) Frontend Wizard UI - 3 mode buttons (Auto suchen/IP manuell/USB Pfad), 3 step indicators with dynamic labels, role/name/type selectors, discovery panel with subnet inputs, USB panel with device input, save/test/diagnostics buttons. (3) Save Gate - Save button disabled (opacity 0.5) until printerVerified=true after successful test. (4) Discovery - Returns empty in preview (expected - no real LAN printers). (5) USB Auto-Suche - NOT YET IMPLEMENTED (manual path entry only, noted in UI). Route is /admin/tables not /restaurant/admin/tables.
